violations.description: Ensures the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
violations.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds

nodes.html: This domain is for use in illustrative examples...

explanation.plainEnglish: Low-vision and color-blind readers may not be able to read this text because it doesn't stand out enough from its background.
explanation.fix: Darken the text color or lighten the background until the contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1 for normal text.

violations.description: Ensures all page content is contained by landmarks
violations.help: All page content should be contained by landmarks

explanation.plainEnglish: Screen reader users rely on landmarks like <main> and <nav> to jump around a page quickly; without them, they have to listen through everything in order.
explanation.fix: Wrap the primary content in a <main> element instead of a plain <div>.

violations.description: Ensures the order of headings is semantically correct
violations.help: Heading levels should only increase by one

explanation.plainEnglish: Skipping from an h1 straight to an h3 breaks the outline screen reader users navigate by, making the page structure confusing.
explanation.fix: Change this heading to h2, or add the missing h2 level before it.

violations.description: Ensures elements have alternate text or a role of none or presentation

explanation.plainEnglish: Blind and low-vision visitors using a screen reader get nothing but 'image' announced for every photo, including the menu photos they'd need to decide what to order.
explanation.fix: Add descriptive alt text, e.g. alt="Fresh almond croissant on a wooden board".

violations.description: Ensures every form element has a label

explanation.plainEnglish: Screen reader users hear only 'edit text' with no indication of what to type into this field, making the order form unusable without sight.
explanation.fix: Add a <label for="order-name">Your name</label> tied to the input's id.

violations.description: Ensures the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds
violations.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds

explanation.plainEnglish: The light grey prices on a white background are hard to read for anyone with low vision, and nearly invisible in bright sunlight on mobile.
explanation.fix: Darken .price-tag to at least #595959 on a white background to hit a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.

explanation.plainEnglish: An icon-only cart link with no text announces as just 'link' to screen readers, giving no clue where it goes.
explanation.fix: Add visually-hidden text: View cart.

explanation.plainEnglish: A '×' symbol alone isn't reliably announced by screen readers, so users may not realize this button closes the popup.

violations.description: Ensures every HTML document has a lang attribute
violations.help: <html> element must have a lang attribute

explanation.plainEnglish: Without a declared language, screen readers may use the wrong pronunciation rules for the entire page.
explanation.fix: Add lang="en" (or the appropriate language code) to the <html> tag.

violations.description: Ensures the document has a main landmark
violations.help: Document should have one main landmark

explanation.plainEnglish: Without a <main> landmark, screen reader users lose the fastest way to skip straight to the page's actual content.
explanation.fix: Wrap the core page content in a single <main> element.

violations.description: Ensures <meta name="viewport"> does not disable text scaling and zooming
violations.help: Zooming and scaling must not be disabled

explanation.plainEnglish: Disabling pinch-to-zoom blocks low-vision users from enlarging text on mobile, one of their most basic accommodations.
explanation.fix: Remove user-scalable=no from the viewport meta tag.
